name: einvoicechecker
title: E-Invoice Checker: EU e-invoice tools
description: Detect, parse, validate and render European e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, Peppol BIS 3.0, UBL, CII, KSeF FA(3)) with the official KoSIT, OpenPeppol and KSeF rule sets.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key> (optional; free key at https://einvoicechecker.com/developers/). Without it the anonymous rate limit applies.

tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.description: Supported formats, rule sets, plans and tool costs.

tools.name: detect_invoice
tools.description: Identify format, syntax, profile and country standard of an e-invoice (XML text or PDF base64).

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Extract the invoice as normalised JSON: parties, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment.

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Validate with the official rule set (KoSIT, OpenPeppol BIS 3.0, KSeF FA(3)); every failed rule with id, severity, XPath.

tools.name: render_invoice_html
tools.description: Readable A4 invoice document as HTML in en/de/fr/pl/nl.

tools.name: render_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Readable PDF of the invoice, returned as a base64 resource (counts as 2 requests).

tools.name: my_usage
tools.description: Plan, quota, usage and subscription of the connected API key.
